expectations.text: Produces complete, self-contained working code for the described task
expectations.evidence: Eight files provided (types, selection, api, useBulkDocumentActions, BulkActionsBar, ConfirmBulkTrashDialog, UndoToast, DocumentsTable) with complete implementations ready to use

expectations.text: Produces actual working component code rather than only a list of recommendations
expectations.evidence: Full TSX implementations of DocumentsTable, BulkActionsBar, ConfirmBulkTrashDialog, UndoToast, and supporting modules with working mutations and state management

expectations.text: Makes the destructive action recoverable rather than relying on a confirmation dialog alone
expectations.evidence: Soft-delete to Trash with 30-day retention + UndoToast component with undo mutation. Dialog text states: 'They move to Trash and are permanently deleted after 30 days. You can restore them from Trash until then.'

expectations.text: Shows the count of affected items before the action is taken
expectations.evidence: BulkActionsBar displays `${formatCount(selection.count)} document...` before any action. ConfirmBulkTrashDialog title shows `Delete {formatCount(count)} document...?` before confirmation input

expectations.text: Distinguishes select-all-on-page from select-all-matching rather than conflating them
expectations.evidence: Selection is discriminated union with `mode: 'include'` vs `mode: 'allMatching'`. Separate banners shown for each: 'All [pageIds.length] documents on this page are selected' with button 'Select all [total] documents matching this filter'

expectations.text: Separates the destructive action from the benign one visually or spatially
expectations.evidence: Archive button: white background, primary styling. Delete button: red border (`border-red-500/60`), red text (`text-red-300`). Separated by vertical divider `<span aria-hidden className="ml-4 h-5 w-px bg-slate-700" />`

expectations.text: Does not make the destructive action the default focus or primary button
expectations.evidence: Archive is styled as primary button (white bg, `font-semibold`). Delete is secondary with danger styling. Archive button comes first in layout, making it the primary action

expectations.text: Notes that the server must enforce the rules, not just the UI
expectations.evidence: Multiple places: 'The server must back this with a unique index on (user_id, idempotency_key)' in api.ts comments. Final section states: 'Hiding the buttons for unpermitted users is not included, because hiding is presentation: the /api/documents/bulk/* endpoints must enforce permissions and tenant scoping themselves'

expectations.text: Closes by naming which misuses the design makes impossible
expectations.evidence: Final section titled 'What this shape makes impossible, and what it doesn't' explicitly lists: 'A bulk action on zero rows can't be expressed', 'A selection can't outlive its filter', 'Double-submission is closed by a required idempotencyKey', etc.
